summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stock Valuation Methods and Min Stock Configuration for DynSoft Pharma. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed. Fixed 2 minor issues during testing: reports.py KeyError and Settings.js NaN display.

minor.issue: KeyError: 'stock' - reports.py was accessing product['stock'] directly instead of using stock_service
minor.fix_applied: Updated reports.py to use get_all_products_with_stock() from stock_service

minor.issue: Endpoint was not reading valuation method from settings when no query param provided
minor.fix_applied: Updated stock.py to read from settings when method param is None

ui_bugs.issue: NaN displayed for stock valuation values due to field name mismatch (total_value vs total_valuation)
ui_bugs.fix_applied: Updated Settings.js to use total_valuation || total_value with fallback

backend: PUT /api/settings can update stock_valuation_method to fifo
PUT /api/settings can update stock_valuation_method to lifo
PUT /api/settings can update stock_valuation_method to fefo
PUT /api/settings can update stock_valuation_method to weighted_average
POST /api/categories can create category with min_stock
POST /api/categories can create category without min_stock (optional)
GET /api/categories returns categories with min_stock field
GET /api/products returns products with calculated min_stock
Products use global default_min_stock when no specific config
Stock valuation method changes with settings
Products have price and expiration_date calculated by valuation method
frontend: default_min_stock input field present with correct value
Stock valuation method dropdown shows all 4 methods (FEFO, FIFO, LIFO, CMP)
FEFO option has star indicator (⭐) as recommended for pharmacies
Valuation method description updates when selection changes
Settings save successfully with toast notification
Valorisation actuelle du stock section displays correctly

critical_code_review_comments: stock_service.py calculate_prices_by_method function correctly implements all 4 valuation methods (FIFO, LIFO, FEFO, CMP)
FEFO method properly sorts lots by expiration_date ascending and handles lots without expiration dates
Weighted average (CMP) correctly calculates mean price across all lots weighted by quantity
Min stock priority chain (product > category > global) is well implemented in get_product_min_stock()
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/stock.py - Updated valuation endpoint to read from settings
seed_data_creation: Test categories created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock valuation system fully tested. Settings model supports default_min_stock and stock_valuation_method (fifo, lifo, fefo, weighted_average). Category model has optional min_stock field for override. Product min_stock calculated with priority: product config > category > global default. FEFO method recommended for pharmacies (shown with star indicator). All valuation methods working correctly in both backend calculation and frontend display.
